attrs.author: MiniMax AI
attrs.summary: MiniMax M2.7 is a 229B parameter text model built for software engineering and long-horizon agentic workflows. It's the first model to meaningfully participate in its own development: an internal version ran 100+ autonomous rounds of analyze → modify → evaluate → revert, achieving a 30% improvement on internal programming benchmarks. On SWE-Pro it scores 56.22% (matching GPT-5.3-Codex), 55.6% on VIBE-Pro (near Opus 4.6), and a 66.6% medal rate on MLE Bench Lite — second only to Opus-4.6 and GPT-5.4.
